LLM API cost & model selection guides

Calculate with confidence · compare fairly · estimate accurately

All published guides share one verifiable data source (models.json) and one calculation basis — from "know how to calculate" to "know how to compare" to "know how to estimate": formulas and a worked example in the cost guide, whole-market price differences at fixed assumptions in the pricing comparison, and business-scenario parameters in the cost-scenarios guide.

API cost calculation

How to calculate LLM API costs

Input/output tokens, cache read-write and hit prices, context-length tiers, peak/off-peak handling, price units and multi-currency conventions, monthly usage assumptions with a reproducible worked example, and common mistakes around unknown prices and cross-vendor comparisons.

Model pricing & comparison

LLM API pricing comparison

Estimated monthly costs for 17 mainstream models under identical usage: official list prices per 1M tokens in the original currency, cache prices, context windows, a CNY-converted ranking, and how to read the table for model selection.

Scenario cost cases

Monthly cost scenarios

Monthly costs for three scenarios — chatbot/customer service, RAG knowledge-base Q&A and coding agents — with explicitly labeled assumptions, per-model estimates, cache-hit-rate sensitivity and swap-in-your-own-parameters recalculation.

AI automation workflows

Build an LLM automation workflow with Make

A five-part architecture for calling model APIs from a visual iPaaS (trigger → modules → HTTP call), concept-level steps and failure handling, plus a per-1,000-runs cost table computed from official list prices and retry-amplification analysis (documentation research, not hands-on testing).

Make, n8n or a custom API: choosing a workflow platform

A six-dimension decision framework across deployment, data residency, cost structure, operations and lock-in; unverified vendor pricing is labeled as such, and no product is declared the winner.
